subject: Risk & Compliance
title: CEO Duality Debate
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on CEO Duality Debate.

hook.text: One person is both CEO and board chair. They oversee themselves. What could go wrong?

buildup.text: CEO duality means the same person leads management and the board that's supposed to check management.

discovery.text: In the UK, splitting the roles is standard. In the US, over 50% of S&P 500 companies combine them.

twist.text: Defenders say one leader provides faster decisions. Critics say it eliminates the most important check.

climax.text: CEO duality is one of the oldest governance debates. The answer depends on trust in the individual.

punchline.text: Run the company and oversee yourself. A governance gamble.

quiz.question: What is CEO duality?
options: One person serves as both CEO and board chair
The CEO serves on two company boards
